integrity: Six explicit primitive necklaces, their unbordered conjugates, all 1296 possible transversals, and codeword witnesses are independently regenerated by the bundled standard-library checker. No independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite binary fixed-Hamming-weight-four classification only for lengths 4 through 12; no extrapolation to higher lengths or other weights; historical priority remains subject to independent checking.
title: The first four-one non-overlapping necklace deficit occurs at length twelve
